description: Careful Light Kit version of plan B (no barrier in the kit): the generator stands on the basin platform instead of behind the barrier; otherwise B's shelter-then-ferry approach is unchanged: the orchard crosses before the lava, a skiff takes the research group from its dock, a second skiff ferries the waterfront, the high village waits in the quay shelter and leaves by skiff, and the harbour mouth is cooled in the last window.
